pageTitle: Duet Mail for Dive Shops | AI Email Assistant
metaDescription: Duet Mail helps dive shop owners and PADI instructors respond to certification inquiries, trip bookings, and gear questions instantly — even from underwater.

verticalFaqs.question: Does Duet understand certification levels and course requirements?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Duet learns your specific courses — Open Water, Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster — along with prerequisites, duration, pricing, and what's included. When someone asks about getting certified, Duet drafts a reply with the right course details, schedule, and next steps. You review and send.

verticalFaqs.question: I'm on the boat or underwater all day. Can I use Duet from my phone?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Duet works with Gmail and Outlook, so it works wherever your email works — including your phone. Drafts appear automatically in your inbox. Between dives or back at the dock, you review and send with one tap. Most dive operators tell us it saves them 1-2 hours of email time per day during peak season.

pricingNote: At $150/dive with a group of 6, one saved trip pays for over a year of Pro.
